children: Apollo's maiden resource outlines 2.58 Moz AuEq indicated and 2.83 Moz inferred, with high-grade open pit and underground zones. The deposit remains open for expansion, with 40,000m of new drilling since the cut-off and ongoing technical, environmental, and metallurgical studies. Key milestones include an environmental license application in H2 2027 and a resource update in Q1 2028.
